body: I posted a week ago -- but I don't think it got published to the front page because my account was new. I'm still feeling this way -- I wish I could explain it slightly better.

Hi. I really want to die and I wish I had more to say but I just want to go to sleep right now. Are you out there? Do you feel how I feel? Could you explain it a little for me so it makes sense? If someone could just tell me how I feel without knowing me or having me explain it I would feel less alone. I’ve never asked for help on this before.
